method.primary: Five 30-second trials per case after seven-second warmup; identical archived bytecode and case order; alternating case-order reversal within each block.
method.secondary: Three 20-second trials for two/eight maps and each 500/1024-pixel case.
method.confidence: 5000 independent trial-resampling bootstrap draws of median ratios; seed 20261022. Five-trial intervals are descriptive and omit systematic uncertainty.
method.observer: 20 Hz STATUS; expensive describe/transition readback is at sample boundaries. Boundary-only observer checks reported separately.
method.foreground: fg10 retains full app_tick intervals. io10 measures actual bounded USB/digital-input polls before and after engine work. Steady deltas use existing STATUS replies, excluding boundary-only describe calls.

limitations: No optical/electrical probe; contribution stamps describe software driver completion, not observed light.
Baseline firmware has no comparable displayed-age/input stamps, stack watermark or steady ingress counter.
Basic internal telemetry overhead is not isolated from necessary runtime bookkeeping; observer cost is a separate measurement.
Pico 2 W, APA102, multiple physical outputs and external electrical timing still require the corresponding hardware.
One board and one run order are the primary comparison; the later baseline return block checks drift separately when present.
ASan/UBSan ran on host; LeakSanitizer is unavailable on this macOS host.
